name: Foldingathome
description: Folding@home is a distributed computing project for simulating protein dynamics, including the process of protein folding and the movements of proteins implicated in a variety of diseases. It brings together citizen scientists who volunteer to run simulations of protein dynamics on their personal computers. Insights from this data are helping scientists to better understand biology, and providing new opportunities for developing therapeutics.
short_desc: Folding@home is a distributed computing project for simulating protein dynamics, including the process of protein foldin
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: ACCOUNT_TOKEN
form_fields.hint: Register for an account on https://app.foldingathome.org and retrieve account token in settings. Required on first start.

form_fields.label: MACHINE_NAME
form_fields.hint: Assign a friendly name to this instance (no spaces). Required on first start.

form_fields.label: CLI_ARGS
form_fields.hint: Optionally pass additional cli arguments to fah-client on container start.
